identity.name: BR 03-92 Steel
identity.one_liner: The 42mm square-instrument three-hand watch — the 1990s cockpit-panel design language that has defined Bell & Ross since the BR 01.

narrative.story: The BR 03 is the 42mm civilian version of the 46mm BR 01 (2005), which was itself a wristwatch interpretation of an airplane cockpit clock. The "circle within a square" case reads as an instrument panel — the Bell & Ross design brief since the brand's 1992 founding. The BR-CAL.302 caliber is a Sellita SW300-1 base. The BR 03-92 Steel is the most-cited Bell & Ross and the watch a collector cites when they want a square-case sport watch that is not a Monaco.
narrative.collector_notes: The BR 03 is the 42mm case; the BR 01 is 46mm (discontinued); the BR S is 39mm. The four visible bezel screws are a direct cockpit-clock reference.
